note: Halo has not launched. Public site versions are 0.x product-diary numbers, not the 1.0 release and not necessarily the MSIX identity. Hide items with published=false.

releases.headline: Toward 1.0: floating surface, clipboard library, workspaces, signed updates
releases.summary: Work in the tree between 0.10.0 and launch. Do not render on the public changelog until it ships.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a floating island path so Halo can sit as a self-contained pill on displays that have no camera housing.
Added named workspaces for Home layout, widget styles, and enabled modules, including per-display binding.
Added a Clipboard Library window with search, filters, list/grid/board views, and bulk actions; the notch stays a 40-item hot cache.
Added on-device OCR indexing, sensitive-content masking, Quick Paste, and paste sequences.
Added a signed direct-MSIX update path with truthful Idle, Checking, Available, Downloading, Ready, Current, and Failed states.
Added a versioned first-party module catalog and a signed external-provider contract.
Added durable file-shelf operations with queued copy, move, and convert.
Added per-display surface profiles that survive unplug and topology changes.
Added a diagnostics bundle, idle performance telemetry, and a single-instance guard.
Added settings schema migrations and recovery for a bad JSON file.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Replaced the Settings Store-launcher dead end with a real checker that fails closed until production signing pins exist.
Hardened clipboard persistence onto SQLite with size budgets and sensitivity rules.
Tightened display identity so mixed-DPI and hot-plug no longer collapse every monitor into the first one seen.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Split accessibility and privacy into an explicit pre-1.0 gate.
Kept the live Home row at six tiles even as the catalog and workspaces grow.
Documented the public site needs that 1.0 still owes: download verification, changelog, privacy, and support.

releases.headline: Live Activities, and a new face for Halo
releases.summary: The notch can host a primary live card plus compact secondaries, and Halo finally has its own brand.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.10.0: expanded media with Playing Next as a live activity.
Halo 0.10.0: calendar event reminder as a live activity with Focus, Snooze, Dismiss, and Join.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a Live Activity coordinator so media, timers, the assistant, calendar, downloads, notifications, apps, file operations, calls, recording, transcription, and exports share one arbitration model.
Added live-activity actions on the surface so a timer, a meeting, or a download can be handled without opening Settings.
Added a new Halo brand system: redrawn app icons at every Windows target size, store listing tiles, and a master logo.
Added richer clipboard item metadata so Clips can participate in live-activity promotion.
Added live-activity tests for coordinator policy and on-surface metrics.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Settings, Notes, Notification Center, and Onboarding windows mixing leftover placeholder logos.
Fixed avatar peek painting and expression timing after the Live Activity chrome landed.
Fixed media session artwork and source-app badges on live cards.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Rebuilt Settings around the live-activity era, including a Surface preview that pushes Home, Media, Timer, Call, Notification, or Tray onto the real notch.
Tightened geometry so compact secondary indicators stay small and never compete with the primary title.
Softened onboarding and tray-icon copy to match the new mark.
Kept the outer canvas optically pure black.
Updated presentation geometry so a promoted activity morphs with the existing spring.

releases.headline: Every Home widget gets its own look
releases.summary: Clock, apps, battery, weather, and new utility tiles remember how you like them drawn.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.9.0: Home dashboard with restyleable widgets.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added persistent per-widget display styles for Clock, Apps, Battery, Weather, and Microphone.
Added eleven Clock presentations: digital + date, flip, recording, countdown, date + weather, focus, calendar day, stopwatch, analog, digital + seconds, and minimal digital.
Added Apps styles: launcher glyph, live folder, and color folder.
Added Battery charging vs. level, Weather temperature vs. condition, and Microphone level vs. waveform.
Added Downloads, Processor, and Microphone as first-class Home widgets, with a real CPU sampler.
Added interactive Clock modes for timer, countdown, stopwatch, and focus from the Home row.
Added layout math that respects each style’s own width.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Home hit-testing so a restyled wider or narrower tile still receives the click meant for it.
Fixed module-board previews drifting from the live notch after style changes.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Kept the live Home row at six tiles. Style is a presentation choice, not a seventh widget.
Preserved 84-DIP row height and the 124-pixel reference canvases.
Wired the module board to the new style catalog so editor and notch read the same data.

releases.headline: Capture, weather, modules, and a Home you can rearrange
releases.summary: Halo becomes a kit: sixteen widget kinds, a module catalog, screen capture, weather, High Alert, and a command palette.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.8.0: Home dashboard with rearrangeable widgets.
Halo 0.8.0: Control Center from time and battery.
Halo 0.8.0: favorite apps with real shell icons.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a Home widget board with sixteen kinds: Radio, Clock, Weather, Apps, Battery, Media, Next Event, Notes, Timer, Quick Toggles, Outputs, Notify, Downloads, Processor, Microphone, and Utilities.
Added a visual module catalog of fifteen first-party modules with enable, disable, and reorder.
Added screen capture for region, window, and fullscreen, with annotation stamps and a color picker overlay.
Added a command palette for jumping to Halo actions without hunting Settings.
Added Open-Meteo weather on Home, consent-first, with no account.
Added High Alert stay-awake so the PC can refuse sleep when you asked it to keep working.
Added Pomodoro sessions as a first-party timer mode.
Added TermiNotch, an in-notch ConPTY terminal, plus a hotkey to toggle it.
Added window snap layouts and Explorer Send to Halo.
Added meeting hotkeys and extra call actions: mute, camera, and share.
Added media source lock and side buttons so a chosen player keeps the notch.
Added note markup, a notification inbox, clip inbox, audio-peak visualization, camera framing, and private convert jobs.
Added Focus Assist probing so notification policy can respect Windows quiet mode.
Added rebindable hotkeys for capture, color pick, command palette, pinned note, and the terminal.
Added clipboard history limits and echo suppression so pasting does not recapture itself.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed notification conversation tracking so replies and reactions stay attached to the toast they came from.
Fixed drop-action filtering so Convert, Zip, Unzip, and Play in Music only appear when the files can use them.
Fixed localization gaps for the new drop actions, modules, and capture commands across all ten languages.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Extended media transport and routing so queue, output, and lock state survive the new Home composer.
Tightened default drop actions to a four-chip strip: Shelf, Share, Convert, Zip.
Gave Home a composer of its own rather than painting modules as one-off hub branches.
Kept capture, weather, and High Alert as real services with tests, not decorative toggles.
Added dashboard visual assets so the marketing site could show Home as a product.

releases.headline: Playing Next, outputs, calendar tasks, a floating dock
releases.summary: Expanded media grows a queue and a speaker picker. Calendar grows tasks. The station bar can leave the top edge.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.7.0: expanded media player.
Halo 0.7.0: Playing Next overlay on expanded media.
Halo 0.7.0: calendar week, agenda, and tasks.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a Playing Next overlay on expanded media so the upcoming queue is a real surface.
Added an audio output picker on expanded media: enumerate playback devices and switch the default.
Added calendar tasks beside Windows appointments, with a phrase parser for dated tasks.
Added a station-placement setting for a floating bottom dock.
Added Spotify Connect queue APIs and wider OAuth scopes.
Added clipboard paste actions and tighter deduplication.
Added Windows Share as a first-class drop destination.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed clipboard captures of the same payload stacking as unique rows.
Fixed drag-and-drop catalogs so media files and ordinary files do not share one ineligible action list.
Fixed calendar agenda geometry after the task row landed.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Split the surface host into Calendar, Dock, and Media Chrome partials.
Updated design tokens for queue rows, device rows, and dock hit targets.
Kept Share, Convert, and device switching on native OS APIs.

releases.headline: Spotify Connect
releases.summary: Play this can leave the desktop app and talk to Spotify’s player API.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.6.7: expanded media with optional Spotify Connect.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added Spotify Connect with PKCE OAuth. Tokens live in the Windows credential vault, never in settings.json.
Added Settings → Media connection UI with a clear Premium requirement. Halo does not stream audio.
Added a structured play-track result so the mascot can say whether the track started, needs Premium, or fell back.
Extended the keyword parser for title by artist so Connect and desktop search share one query shape.
Bumped settings schema to 14 for the Spotify client ID.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed play requests that used to fail closed with no spoken reason.
Fixed fallback to the desktop-shortcut path when Connect is not configured.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Kept cloud answers off the shipped path. Connect is optional music control, not a Halo account.
Documented that voice play through Connect is a Premium Spotify feature.

releases.headline: Smarter play title by artist
releases.summary: Track resolution stops guessing the first search hit.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added title-by-artist parsing for spoken and typed play commands.
Added MusicBrainz-assisted matching on top of Spotify search.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed media session calls that could throw on a disappearing GSMTC session and take the surface down.
Fixed assistant command flow so a new request clears stale chat history.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Lengthened the search HTTP timeout so a slow provider is a delay, not a false miss.
Tightened search-result scoring before the desktop UI-Automation fallback runs.

releases.headline: Spotify on the desktop, Settings rebuilt
releases.summary: If Connect is off, Halo can still drive the Spotify desktop app. Settings finally looks like a product.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added Spotify desktop control: quick search plus UI Automation to confirm and play a result in the installed app.
Added junk-transcript filtering and silence detection for Whisper.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed local model-store assertions after the download UI landed.
Fixed media-query mocks so shuffle, repeat, and replay coverage matches the desktop path.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Rebuilt Settings with a flush-left sidebar, in-window search, updated theme brushes, and a layout that resizes instead of clipping.
Shortened assistant launch-hold and follow-up conversation rules.
Kept Settings chrome fully opaque — no Mica, no Acrylic.

releases.headline: Search and play across your music apps
releases.summary: Play, replay, shuffle, repeat, and what’s on my PC become assistant intents.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.6.4: expanded media transport with search-driven playback.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added assistant intents for play track, replay, repeat, shuffle, date, time, list apps, and status.
Added cross-provider music search for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, and a web fallback.
Added a Whisper model catalog from Tiny through Large v3 / Distil, downloadable and deletable locally.
Added persistent chat history for a follow-up turn after a command.
Added PC-environment formatting for spoken answers about battery, volume, time, and now-playing.
Extended the media session service with shuffle, repeat, replay, and direct track playback.
Bumped settings schema to 13 for the selected speech model.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed typewriter text on the AI station clipping mid-glyph.
Fixed media source-hint matching so on Spotify and in Music resolve to the right session.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Put live transcripts and model choice on the AI hub instead of a debug window.
Kept every speech model on-device. Nothing is uploaded for recognition.

releases.headline: Close it, minimize it, watch the mascot react
releases.summary: Voice can close or minimize the app you named, and the face has opinions.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added close app and minimize app intents.
Added avatar reactions that change with intent, conversation state, and whether the command succeeded.
Added delete-and-size labels on local speech and language-model files.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Overhauled app resolution with soundex, fuzzy matching, and abbreviation handling.
Fixed assistant message layout: wrapping, avatar sizing, and Settings AI copy.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Made failure a facial expression, not only a sentence.
Kept destructive model deletes in Settings, behind an explicit remove.

releases.headline: Whisper, brightness HUD, the AI station
releases.summary: Speech moves on-device, brightness gets a pulse, and AI becomes a station next to Home.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.6.2: Control Center with brightness alongside volume and radios.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added the AI station on expanded chrome: face, status, Listen, suggestion chips, last reply.
Added on-device speech via Whisper alongside the Windows Speech API path.
Added a brightness HUD that pulses when the display level changes.
Added a local model store with progress-tracked downloads.
Added system intents for volume, brightness, and Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / Airplane radios.
Added WhatsApp to the voice app-launch aliases.
Localized every new AI string across the ten Halo languages.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Settings page naming so AI is a real nav item.
Fixed geometry around the AI station so the mascot and transcript share Home-sized chrome without clipping.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Kept Assistant off until Settings → AI is enabled. Halo is not always listening.
Documented the optional xAI key field as a non-shipped cloud path. Free-form answers use the on-device model.

releases.headline: Open apps by voice, answers on this PC
releases.summary: Open Edge works. Free-form questions can stay on the machine.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a fuzzy app-launch resolver with common aliases, wired into favorite apps.
Added on-device language-model support with a progress-tracked download.
Added a microphone peak meter so the idle notch visualizes listening.
Added an assistant launch presentation when a voice command starts an app.
Taught the parser to extract media-source targets and app-launch commands.
Extended media sessions so Halo can aim transport at a named app.
Added boot-greeting avatar clips.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed blink timing so greetings and listen clips do not fight the idle blink.
Fixed idle geometry after the accessory rail landed so the peek still sits on the left.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Actions still run without a language model: timers, transport, volume, brightness, radios, calendar, clipboard, open, close, minimize.
The model is for questions Halo cannot turn into an action, and you can delete it.

releases.headline: Talk to Halo
releases.summary: Click the face, or press Win + Alt + A. The notch listens, then does something.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added an opt-in in-app assistant, off by default, on Settings → AI.
Added Win + Alt + A, rebindable, to start a listen session.
Added Windows Speech Recognition with command phrases for timers, media, and clipboard.
Added secure API-key storage through the Windows Password Vault.
Added assistant glance notifications on the compact notch.
Added a debug window for assistant and speech logs.
Added microphone and internet capabilities to the packaged manifest, requested only when Assistant is used.
Bumped settings schema to 12.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed logging so assistant traces can appear in the debug window without spamming the tray.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Sessions start from face click, hotkey, later the AI station, or a typed Ask Halo. There is no wake-word running in the background.
Private data stays local. Clipboard context for what did I copy is a separate opt-in.

releases.headline: A face in the notch
releases.summary: Halo stops being an empty pill. A mascot peeks from the left of idle chrome.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a resident mascot peek on the idle notch — authored 3D-to-2D faces.
Added ten official variants: Halo, Citrus, Cubee, Cloudee, Freddy, Grok bot, Kirby, Nova, Onee, and Sunee.
Added Settings → Halo for variant choice, body and eye recolor, and reset to the variant palette.
Added idle, hover-curious, and poke hit-testing: empty bar opens Home; the face is its own target.
Added blink, ambient idle, and expression playback with reduce-motion respect.
Embedded variant packages so a face works offline on first launch.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed idle geometry so the peek occupies a dedicated left rail instead of colliding with compact media.
Fixed hover so holding the face does not expand Home out from under a poke.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Kept the silhouette black. The face lives in the notch, it is not a second window.
Preview clips in Settings use the same projector the live peek uses.

releases.headline: Clips — text, images, files, and color
releases.summary: Clipboard history grows up. Clips is no longer a text dump.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.4.0: Clips with preview cards for text, images, files, and color.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added multi-type clipboard capture: text, images, files, and color swatches.
Added a Clips UI with category filters, preview cards, and relative-age labels.
Reworked native clipboard interop so paste restores the original type.
Added design tokens and item-kind enums for later library and OCR work.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed history items that used to collapse images and files into text-like rows.
Updated marketing screenshots so Clips on the site matches the new cards.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Kept Clips opt-in and local. Nothing leaves the PC.
Foreground paste still excludes Halo’s own window, so copying from Clips does not echo.

releases.headline: Write without leaving the notch
releases.summary: Notes get an in-notch editor. Calendar gets a real month. Craft gets sharper.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.3.0: in-notch Notes editor with title, body, and checklist.
Halo 0.3.0: Notes list on the notch.
Halo 0.3.0: four-row calendar month and day agenda.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added an in-notch Notes editor: title, body, checklist, autosave; back returns to the list.
Rebuilt the calendar month as a 4-row, 28-day grid.
Added foreground-aware clipboard paste that never pastes into Halo itself.
Added Hub actions for calendar navigation and editor interactions.
Added the first marketing screenshot set, captured from the live notch on white.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Settings loading copy that still talked like a stub.
Fixed clipboard test mocks after the foreground-paste path landed.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Improved GDI+ decoding with high-quality scaling and correct alpha compositing.
Raised app-icon extraction to 512×512 so notch badges stay crisp on high-DPI displays.
Converted drop-action image exports through System.Drawing for direct PNG output.
Tightened Bluetooth, media, and status tokens after the first visual QA pass.

releases.headline: Home, Control Center, and the rest of the desk
releases.summary: The notch learns radios, calendar, notes, brightness, drop actions, and ten languages.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.2.0: Home dashboard.
Halo 0.2.0: Control Center.
Halo 0.2.0: Bluetooth devices with battery percent.
Halo 0.2.0: Windows Calendar week and agenda.
Halo 0.2.0: event reminder with Join.
Halo 0.2.0: drop actions on files dragged onto the notch.
Halo 0.2.0: local Notes list.

sections.title: New Features
items: Renamed the Nook hub to Home — live media, favorite apps, modules, time, and battery in one dashboard.
Added Control Center from time and battery: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth radio, Airplane, volume, and brightness.
Added Bluetooth device rows with battery percent when the device reports it.
Added Windows Calendar: week strip, day agenda, and event reminders with Focus, Snooze, Dismiss, and Join.
Added local Notes stored under %LocalAppData%\Halo\notes.
Added Drop Actions: Shelf, Share, Open with, Zip, Unzip, Convert, Move to, Copy to, plus OneDrive and Play in Music.
Added display brightness as its own integration.
Added localization for English, Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Greek, Indonesian, Japanese, Spanish, Korean, and Turkish, or Match Windows.
Added a dedicated Notes window for longer writing.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed clipped station labels and tight geometry after Home replaced Nook.
Fixed packaging manifests and project references so Bluetooth, Calendar, Notes, and Localization build as first-class assemblies.
Updated tests for the new modules and for copy that still said Nook.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Kept every new capability on native Windows APIs: WinRT radios, Windows appointment store, local files.
Updated onboarding to teach Home, not a code-name hub.
Added reference visual captures so later pixel QA had a baseline.

releases.headline: First light — a Dynamic Island for Windows
releases.summary: A native, quiet, focus-safe notch. Media, files, timers, calls, settings, and the silhouette itself.

screenshots.alt: Halo 0.1.0: expanded Windows media player on the notch.
Halo 0.1.0: Files Tray holding dragged Explorer items.
Halo 0.1.0: favorite apps with real icons.
Halo 0.1.0: timer running on the notch.
Halo 0.1.0: incoming call chrome.
Halo 0.1.0: connected call chrome.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a topmost, no-activate tool window that does not steal focus and does not appear in Alt+Tab or the taskbar.
Added an attached, optically pure-black notch with inverted scoop shoulders at the top center of a chosen display.
Added Idle, Compact, and Expanded chrome with interruptible spring morphs and optional expand-on-hover.
Added path-based hit-testing so clicks outside the silhouette pass through to the desktop.
Added per-pixel alpha and supersampled silhouette fidelity at every DPI.
Added multi-monitor placement, mixed-DPI geometry, and hot-plug recovery.
Added session lock hide and unlock restore.
Added fullscreen policy: hide, always show, Presentation Mode, and per-process overrides.
Added Windows media via GSMTC: compact now-playing, expanded player, transport, and seek.
Added a Core Audio volume HUD and mute pulse.
Added battery, charging, low, and critical activities.
Added timers with presets, custom minutes, pause, resume, cancel, and a complete state.
Added a Caps Lock compact indicator and a default-audio-device activity.
Added packaged notification listening with Settings-first permission onboarding.
Added incoming and connected call chrome with accept and decline.
Added Files Tray: drag from Explorer, hold, open, remove, clear, drag back out.
Added opt-in local clipboard history for text.
Added favorite apps with real package logos and shell icons.
Added Quick Controls, global hotkeys, and full rebinding.
Added a native WinUI 3 Settings app, live display calibration, autostart, tray icon, and first-run onboarding.
Added light, dark, and Match Windows themes, accent colors, and Reduce Motion.
Added an idle performance gate: cold-idle CPU median under 0.5% and working set at or under 150 MiB.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Stabilized Tray so opening Files Tray no longer paints media into the shelf geometry.
Stabilized empty-Tray keep-open so a shelf with no files still holds its size.
Stabilized compact media padding and station-row hit testing so a Tray miss does not shove the notch sideways.
Fixed working-set regressions by deferring the Settings window until it is asked for.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Established design tokens for geometry, spacing, motion, and content craft.
Established product principles later versions are not allowed to violate: quiet until relevant, no focus steal, local-first privacy, native Windows identity, pure-black outer canvas.
Established the test spine for surface, orchestrator, geometry, media, audio, power, shelf, settings, hotkeys, and notifications.
